name: typesafe-tools
description: Bounded Jev evaluation, capability routing, and computer-use action advice for eligible tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Route eligible tasks and advise on computer-use actions.
interface.longDescription: Jev ranks available skills and tools for eligible public, synthetic, or opted-in private tasks. Private-data processing requires protected configuration. An optional computer-use pilot reuses bounded browser and native-app action code while Codex reviews advice and verifies results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check TypeSafe readiness and route an eligible task among available capabilities; private content requires private_data_enabled: true in fresh status.
